content: Do not use any tools. Write exactly four sentences explaining what a context window is and why it limits a conversation.

A context window is the amount of text an AI model can consider at one time. It includes relevant parts of the conversation, instructions, and sometimes tool outputs or other provided content. Because this space is finite, older messages may need to be shortened, summarized, or removed as new messages arrive. Therefore, very long conversations can cause earlier details to become unavailable to the model and may reduce continuity.
